newsitem.title: INDIA: Britain's Major arrives in India.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Major arrives in India.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major arrived in India on Thursday at the start of a three-nation tour of South Asia.
Major was accompanied by more than 50 top British businessmen as he arrived in Calcutta for the weeklong tour of India, Pakistan and Bangladesh aimed at boosting British trade in the region.

Major, who was to address Indian businessmen later on Thursday, said in a statement upon arrival from London that the visit "could be no clearer demonstration of the confidence of British business in the potential of the Indian economy".

During his visit to the region, he plans to meet Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda, Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and Pakistan's caretaker premier, Meraj Khalid, as well as opposition leaders.

The British prime minister, who was on his last big foreign trip before an election, was scheduled to visit Calcutta and the southern city of Bangalore before leaving on Friday for Dhaka. From Bangladesh he was scheduled to travel to Islamabad.
Major's trip coincided with India and Pakistan's 50th anniversary of independence from Britain.
